scope: Localize the feedback-dependent ~210ms bursting in the existing manual neural model; not model optimization or physiological proof
selection_reason: Actual inhibitory inputs to the two DNg100 cells, ranked using observed spike counts, signed edges and per-source release/receptor factors; includes delayed GNG458 rather than only highest synapse-count rows
controls: Original two DNg100160pA200–1500ms protocol and all intrinsic parameters retained; distinguish selective DN-route cuts from whole-cell silence
seed: deterministic kernel, no random stimulus used
repeated_check_policy: Adaptive follow-up only when initial perturbations reveal unresolved mechanisms; no training restarted
